evidence.quote: The three-year graduate is expected to acquire important skills in industrial and information engineering, together with knowledge in economics and management.
Lessons are delivered in English, mainly in person, with the option of attending them live online if necessary.

notes: Tuition: no single EUR amount for a non-EU international student is quoted on the supplied pages; the tuition pages are not among the supplied pages, so tuition is left out. Intakes: no dated start or application deadline (with day, month and year) for non-EU applicants appears on the supplied pages; only a pre-enrolment reference for A.Y. 2026/2027 without a deadline, so intakes are left out. Application channel: the programme page mentions a pre-enrolment procedure for international non-EU students but the supplied text does not name Universitaly, and no university application portal is named for this programme, so applicationChannel is left out. Documents: the general documentation page lists required documents for first-cycle degrees but does not state that the quoted translations are required for this specific programme; the translation sentence is present ('Traduzione giurata (o legalizzata) dei documenti sopra elencati'), so documents are left out to avoid attributing generic institution-wide lists to this programme.
